title: ::: K-IG 교육 영어듣기훈련프로그램 | 기초2 | 제 001 회 강의 :::
label: [ K-IG 교육 Reading 215 ]

blocks.text: People are happy with developments in medicine. Then they worry about the increased number of births. Scientists make great advances in agricultural chemistry, greatly increasing our food supply. Then our rivers become so polluted that we cannot even swim in them. We are happy with the developments in air transportation and impressed by the great airplanes. Then we are frightened by the horrors of air crash or air war. We are excited by the fact that space can now be entered. But we will undoubtedly see the other side there, too.

readingSentences.english: People are happy with developments in medicine.
Then they worry about the increased number of births.
Scientists make great advances in agricultural chemistry, greatly increasing our food supply.
readingSentences.korean: 과학자들이 농화학 분야에서 거대한 진보를 이루어, 식량공급을 크게 증가시켰다.

readingSentences.english: Then our rivers become so polluted that we cannot even swim in them.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 우리의 강은 너무 오염되 수영도 할 수 없다.

readingSentences.english: We are happy with the developments in air transportation and impressed by the great airplanes.
readingSentences.korean: 우리는 항공교통의 발전에 기뻐하고 거대한 비행기에 감동 받는다.

readingSentences.english: Then we are frightened by the horrors of air crash or air war.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 비행기의 추락이나 공중전의 공포에 겁먹는다.

readingSentences.english: We are excited by the fact that space can now be entered.
readingSentences.korean: 우리는 지금 우주에 들어갈 수 있다는 사실에 흥분한다.

readingSentences.english: But we will undoubtedly see the other side there, too.
readingSentences.korean: 그러나 우리는 또한 분명히 그에 있어 다른 측면을 보게 될 것이다.
